properties.name: Menderes

properties.note: Chosen by scripts/propose_calibration_candidates.py --priority as a place to start: among the cells holding Türkiye's densest quarter of buildings (from 133 bldg/km2), the 1 km window with the most roof area in buildings of 1,000 m2 or more (390 such buildings, 74.8 ha of roof; 1,104 buildings in all, 1,104 per km2, VIDA).
